plainTranslation: With Composite Pluto in the 5th house, love can be passionate and passion can be all-consuming. There can be obsession, jealousy, and clinginess in a personal relationship, especially a romantic one, and you need to allow each other to have some space, otherwise you suffocate. You can have strong creative energy between you. In a parent-child relationship, one of you may try to dominate the other, and you can change one another.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
